summary: Banco Santander (Brasil) S.A. filed a Form 6-K announcing the issuance of subordinated financial bills totaling BRL 600,300,000, with a 10-year maturity and a repurchase option starting in 2031. Proceeds will be used to compose the company's Tier II Reference Equity under BCB Resolution No. 122. This is a routine regulatory capital transaction, not a special-situation event. It involves standard debt issuance to private investors, with no equity, control, or structural changes. The filing is informational in nature and does not trigger any special-situation category.
